steps.name: Inspect Ticket
steps.description: Checking the ticket's folder, branch, worktree, merge request and state history

steps.name: Classify
steps.description: A harness, project or environment issue, with its reasoning, as Blocked classifies (ASS-107 AC4): a harness or project issue's ticket raised where facts.js fixTicketIn says; an environment issue repaired as Blocked repairs one (ASS-124)

steps.name: Repair the Environment
steps.description: No fix ticket (ASS-124): the sampled ticket goes to its own Blocked at Blocked's repair step, which repairs it in its VM or worktree as for any block — resumed when repaired, else Blocked for Human with what was found and what to do; where its engine has no such repair, straight to Blocked for Human, saying so. While an agent works on the ticket (exit 2) it waits, tried again each minute; a failure (exit 1) is logged and the check done

steps.name: Create Ticket
steps.description: Raising a ticket for the problem found, where Classify said (facts.js fixTicketIn)
